livetennisapi-polymarket-tennis-polymark.description: Build observe-only Polymarket and Kalshi tennis market tooling on the polymarket-tennis Python package (MIT) plus the Live Tennis API free tier. Use when asked for a Polymarket tennis bot or market watcher, a Kalshi tennis trading bot, tennis prediction-market data, Gamma API tennis markets, matching a market to a live match, break-point or serving state next to market prices, or how a tennis retirement, walkover, or cancelled match settles (venue rule text, never hard-coded). Covers the real package API (GammaClient, LiveTennisClient, discover_tennis_markets, match_market, build_view,…
